title: You lose 30,000 skin cells every minute #shorts
description:
You shed about 30,000–40,000 skin cells every minute — tens of millions a day. New cells form at the bottom of the epidermis and take roughly 2–4 weeks to reach the surface.
Math: 30,000 × 1,440 ≈ 43 million a day.
Sources: Cleveland Clinic; KidsHealth (Nemours) 'Your Skin' (30,000–40,000 per minute; 2 weeks to a month to rise).

Inner Numbers — your body, counted. New Short every day.
Educational content, not medical advice.

scenes.say: In the last minute, you lost about thirty thousand skin cells.
That's over forty million every single day.
So let's cut through your skin.
New cells are born at the bottom and take two to four weeks to reach the surface.
Then they flake off. The skin you see is always being rebuilt. Follow for more of your body, counted.
